purpose.zh: 在椅子上活动脊柱，缓解久坐僵硬
purpose.en: Move your spine from your chair to ease sitting stiffness.

text.zh: 骨盆后卷背拱起，再前倾挺胸
text.en: Tuck your pelvis and round your back, then tip forward and lift your chest

text.zh: 坐在椅子前部，双脚踩地，手放膝上
text.en: Sit near the front of the chair, feet flat, hands on knees.

text.zh: 配合呼吸慢慢做，每个位置稍停
text.en: Move slowly with your breath and pause in each position.

commonErrors.en: Moving only the head and neck.

cautions.zh: 腰背疼痛时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your back hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
